title: Protecting the P-Trap Water Seal
description: The primary job of a P-trap is maintaining a standing water seal that blocks sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common hazard is trap siphoning, which occurs when improper venting creates negative pressure that pulls the water seal down the drain. Ensuring proper distance between the trap and its vent, along with maintaining correct pipe pitch, prevents vacuum action from breaking this seal. For infrequently used fixtures, periodic water refills or trap primers prevent dry traps caused by evaporation.
